req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /tasks/{task_id} with {"completed": true} must set completed=true and return HTTP 2xx with the updated payload. I design: (1) a positive EP test marking an incomplete task complete (task_id=4, completed=false→true); (2) a positive STC test marking an already-complete task complete again (idempotency, task_id=1); (3) a negative NEG test using a non-existent task_id to verify 404; (4) a BVA test using task_id=1 (minimum valid id in dataset) to mark complete; (5) a DT test sending completed=false to an already-complete task to verify the field is actually written (catches boolean-mutation); (6) a NEG test sending an invalid payload type to verify 422. Each test uses an in-process SQLite DB seeded fresh per test via override of get_db.

import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=4, title='Prepare meeting agenda', description='Harbor matrix', completed=False))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)
r = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'completed': True})
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.json()
assert data['id'] == 4
assert data['completed'] == True
assert data['title'] == 'Prepare meeting agenda'
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf)
